from tests.test_autoscaling.utils import setup_networking
import boto3
from moto import mock_aws
@mock_aws
def _run():
    mocked_networking = setup_networking()
    client = boto3.client("autoscaling", region_name="us-east-1")
    client.create_launch_configuration(LaunchConfigurationName="tcl", ImageId="ami-12345678", InstanceType="t2.medium")
    client.create_auto_scaling_group(AutoScalingGroupName="tasg", LaunchConfigurationName="tcl", MinSize=0, MaxSize=20, DesiredCapacity=2, VPCZoneIdentifier=mocked_networking["subnet1"], NewInstancesProtectedFromScaleIn=False)
    resp = client.describe_auto_scaling_groups(AutoScalingGroupNames=["tasg"])
    ids = [i["InstanceId"] for i in resp["AutoScalingGroups"][0]["Instances"]]
    print("ids", ids)
    assert len(ids)==2, ids
    protected = ids[:1]
    client.set_instance_protection(AutoScalingGroupName="tasg", InstanceIds=protected, ProtectedFromScaleIn=True)
    resp2 = client.describe_auto_scaling_groups(AutoScalingGroupNames=["tasg"])
    states = {i["InstanceId"]: i["ProtectedFromScaleIn"] for i in resp2["AutoScalingGroups"][0]["Instances"]}
    print("states", states)
    assert states[protected[0]] is True, states
    assert states[ids[1]] is False, states
    print("moto_temporal_fetch_filter_apply", True)
_run()
